_comment: The gate fails only on what players feel (user, 2026-10-16): fps below minFps, a frame-interval p95 over maxIntervalP95 ms (stutter) or a worst gap between frames over maxIntervalMs (a hitch or load stall). '*' applies to every scenario in an environment; a scenario's own entry overrides it. Counts (draws, objects, triangles, uploads…) are reported, never gated: the map is still being designed. The one exception is a per-view density limit: maxViewDraws/maxViewTriangles: draws or triangles drawn per frame (the view and its shadow pass, not scene totals), set only from the knee the view-density sweep measured in that environment (docs/PERFORMANCE.md, Density). Leaks across travel and page errors also fail.
